stories.title: Why Honda dealerships may be auto retail’s best acquisition value
stories.summary: First reported in the Q2 2026 Haig Report®, Honda has quietly become one of the best values in auto retail, combining strong throughput and loyal customers with multiples that still trail Toyota by a meaningful margin. stories.title: The Haig Partners Franchise Horsepower Index: Where the real money is
stories.summary: Blue sky multiples tell you what buyers are willing to pay for a franchise, but they do not always reveal the underlying economics of the dealership.
